hook.en: How does a company decide whether to open a new factory or rent one? It follows a definite sequence of steps called the planning process.
hook.kn: ಹೊಸ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಬೇಕೇ ಬಾಡಿಗೆಗೆ ಪಡೆಯಬೇಕೇ ಎಂದು ಕಂಪನಿ ಹೇಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ? ಯೋಜನಾ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಎಂಬ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ.

objectives.en: List the steps of the planning process in order

narration.en: How does a company decide whether to open a new factory or rent one? It follows a definite sequence of steps called the planning process.
narration.kn: ಹೊಸ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಬೇಕೇ ಬಾಡಿಗೆಗೆ ಪಡೆಯಬೇಕೇ ಎಂದು ಕಂಪನಿ ಹೇಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ? ಯೋಜನಾ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಎಂಬ ನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ.

body.en: The steps are: setting objectives; developing premises (assumptions about the future); identifying alternative courses of action; evaluating alternative courses; selecting an alternative; implementing the plan; and follow-up action.

narration.en: The steps are: setting objectives; developing premises (assumptions about the future); identifying alternative courses of action; evaluating alternative courses; selecting an alternative; implementing the plan; and follow-up action.
narration.kn: ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು: ಉದ್ದೇಶ ನಿಗದಿ, ಪೂರ್ವಾನುಮಾನಗಳ ರಚನೆ, ಪರ್ಯಾಯಗಳ ಗುರುತಿಸುವಿಕೆ, ಪರ್ಯಾಯಗಳ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ಅನುಷ್ಠಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಸರಣಾ ಕ್ರಮ.

title.en: On the board: the planning process

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Step one: set objectives. Everything else follows from them.
Step two: develop premises, the assumptions about the future.
Step three: identify alternative courses of action.
Step four: evaluate each alternative, for example by its profit.
Steps five and six: select the best alternative and implement it.
Step seven: follow up to see that the plan works.
Mnemonic: Some Doctors Iron Every Shirt In Fashion.

body.en: Setting objectives, Developing premises, Identifying alternatives, Evaluating, Selecting, Implementing, Follow-up.

mnemonic.en: "Some Doctors Iron Every Shirt In Fashion"

caption.en: Evaluating two alternatives: profit at different sales levels

narration.en: Plan A has fixed cost ₹2 lakh and earns ₹50 per unit. Change the fixed cost and per-unit contribution of Plan B and see where B becomes better than A.

label.en: Sales where both earn equal profit

tryThis.en: At the default values, above how many units is Plan B better?
Raise Plan B's fixed cost: what happens to the equal-profit point?
If expected sales are 12,000 units, which plan would you select?

aim.en: To find the break-even point of a plan and use it to evaluate alternative courses of action.

narration.en: Open the break-even bench. Change fixed cost, price and variable cost, and see how the break-even point of a plan moves. This is one way to evaluate alternatives.

problem.en: Expected sales are 12,000 units. Plan A: fixed cost ₹2,00,000, contribution ₹50 per unit. Plan B: fixed cost ₹5,00,000, contribution ₹80 per unit. Evaluate and select.

steps.en: Equal profit at (5,00,000 − 2,00,000) ÷ (80 − 50) = 10,000 units; sales of 12,000 exceed this.
Select Plan B, then implement it and follow up.

answer.en: Plan B, with ₹60,000 more profit at the expected sales of 12,000 units.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Expected sales are 12,000 units. Plan A: fixed cost ₹2,00,000, contribution ₹50 per unit. Plan B: fixed cost ₹5,00,000, contribution ₹80 per unit. Evaluate and select.
Class quiz. Discuss in your benches, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಬೆಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

homework.en: Explain the steps in the planning process.

narration.en: Recap. Planning starts with setting objectives and developing premises. Alternatives are identified, evaluated and the best is selected. The plan is implemented and followed up.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಯೋಜನೆ ಉದ್ದೇಶ ನಿಗದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ವಾನುಮಾನಗಳಿಂದ ಆರಂಭ. ಪರ್ಯಾಯಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ, ಉತ್ತಮವಾದುದನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಅನುಷ್ಠಾನಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಅನುಸರಣೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
